note: Rewritten from the species description in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India: Isoptera, entry 155; originally in English; only the soldier is known, alates and workers are lacking; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been deleted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides generally nearly parallel, sides swollen in some individuals; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest; clypeus trapezoidal, labrum subpentagonal; mandibles finely and densely serrate, apical half thicker than the basal half, apex strongly hooked; postmentum rod-shaped, waist strongly constricted; pronotum saddle-shaped.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to yellowish brown; antennae yellowish brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; pronotum pale yellow; body and legs yellowish white. Head capsule sparsely pilose; pronotum with a few scattered setae only on the margins and the disc. Head capsule length (to mandibular base) 1.38–1.56 mm, maximum width generally 0.82–0.87 mm, 1.0–1.06 mm in the swollen form; left mandible length 0.78–0.88 mm; postmentum length 0.80–0.92 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm, waist width 0.16–0.22 mm; pronotum length 0.27–0.35 mm, width 0.49–0.61 mm.
